decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp cross-axis shift in N/E around indices 485–544 with sustained offset and unclear return; (2) a pronounced multi-sample drop in N with E surge near 605–625, followed by a high-E/low-N platform and complex superposed behavior. Both show ambiguous or incomplete returns and warrant closer inspection.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample shift in N and E around index 490–495, with N dropping from ~0.3 to ~-1.4 and E rising from ~0.27 to ~1.8, followed by a sustained elevated E (~1.7–2.1) and variable N over ~20 samples; possible opposing return not clearly resolved within window.

Prominent abrupt multi-sample drop in N (from ~-1.2 to ~-3.0) and concurrent E rise (~2.1 to ~4.4) near index 610–615, followed by a plateau-like segment with high E (>3.5) and low N (<-2.5) until ~625; ambiguous superposed changes include later spikes in U and partial recovery in N/E after ~640.
